QuestInfo.name: The Voice from the Stone
QuestInfo.0: After completing the training exercises, you hear a strange sound, almost like a voice. Has some old man lost his way in the woods?
QuestInfo.1: You decided to employ the trick used by Master Tai Yu himself in the Tales of Tai Yu's 21st volume, The Sealing of the Badger Demon.
QuestInfo.2: You really messed up in your attempt to seal the Taotie! It looks like you didn't possess the necessary magical might to bind the Taotie's reckless spirit.
